title: Optifine Old Lighting
description: This project adds the old lighting from Optifine's internal shaders.
body:
Adds OptiFine's (internal) shader with Old Lighting to Iris, recreating the look without needing Optifine installed.

![example](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/908d1c9cc1632ef4bcc24a635fcd6b6359656048.png)

The performance impact is near zero.

We've tested it on 26.1.2, but it should also work on other versions.
